about: X-469 — every unattended start obeys ONE wall (src/core/startRoom.ts startWall: the user's Account ceiling, or a wall a rule, campaign, task or caller names for itself, never above the quota handover line). test/test_start_wall.js reads src/ and fails on a wall written as a number, a wall constant, or a room check that states no wall at all, unless it is listed here. 'exempt' = not a start decision, with why. 'pending' = a known door still on its own line, owned by the named item; pendingBudget may only shrink, and an entry that no longer matches anything fails as stale.

exempt.why: a rule's listed steps were each walled by their own step wall above (accountOf … wallOf); this only orders the survivors by room
asks whether ANY sign-in is usable at all (not rejected, not at the plan's own 100%) — a health fact, not where to start
the primitives' own parameter default; every CALL must state its wall, which this gate checks separately
accountOrder's own option default; every call states its wall
carryOnAccount's own input default; every call states its wall
pickAccount hands its caller's options through unchanged
the plan's own wall (100%): what 'at the wall' means on a usage bar, never where a session starts
the import the 'at the wall' readout uses
a usage bar marked 'at the wall' = the plan itself is full (100%), not a start decision
0 = the caller named no wall of its own: the rule it saves keeps none, and accounts.status hands its figure to accountCeiling, which caps it at the quota handover line
